source.author: verg
source.text: Procedo, et parvam Troiam simulataque magnis Pergama, et arentem Xanthi cognomine rivum aggnosco, Scaeaeque amplector limina portae.
source.text_original: Procedo, et parvam Troiam simulataque magnis / Pergama, et arentem Xanthi cognomine rivum / aggnosco, Scaeaeque amplector limina portae.
source.text_english: I advance, and I recognize little Troy and Pergamon made to resemble the great city, and the dry stream called by the name of Xanthus, and I embrace the threshold of the Scaean gate.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: da reddere terris has animas patriaeque amplecti limina portae.
reuse.text_original: da reddere terris / has animas patriaeque amplecti limina portae.
reuse.text_english: Grant me to restore these souls to the earth and to embrace the threshold of the homeland’s gate.
